in_sanskrit.name: ओम्प्रकाश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Omprakash is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ओम्' (Om) and 'प्रकाश' (prakash), which mean 'Illumination by Om' or 'Shining Forth of the Supreme Self'.

in_hindi.name: ओम्प्रकाश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Omprakash is a combination of two words in the Hindi language - 'ओम्' (Om), which is a sacred syllable in Hinduism, and 'प्रकाश' (prakash), which means 'light' or 'illumination'. Together, the name signifies the 'Illumination by Om' or 'Shining Forth of the Supreme Self'.

in_marathi.name: Omprkash
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Om (God's name) + Prakash (Light)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Omprkash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Omprkash is a Sanskrit name derived from two words - Om and Prakash. Om is the sacred sound and symbol of the Hindu god Brahma, representing the ultimate reality and the cosmos. Prakash means light, knowledge, and wisdom. The name Omprkash signifies the divine light of knowledge and wisdom that illuminates the path of an individual towards spiritual enlightenment.
